facts.fact: Minister Malatsi told Parliament in his budget vote speech that the Draft National AI Policy was withdrawn after generative AI was used irresponsibly in drafting it; date of withdrawal not given, so the speech date is used.
facts.system: South Africa's draft National AI Policy

facts.fact: The minister announced an Independent Expert Review Panel chaired by Prof Benjamin Rosman to review the policy before it is reintroduced for public comment.
